title.narrative: Integrated Health and Nutrition Support for Vulnerable Individuals in the Al Misrakh, Al Mudhafer, Salah Districts, Taiz Gov

description.narrative: ltpgtThis project aims to enhance equitable access to essential health and nutrition services for vulnerable populations, including internally ‎displaced persons (IDPs) and host communities, targeting 42,885 individuals in Taiz Governorate’s Al Misrakh, Al Mudhafer, and Salah ‎districts. The direct beneficiaries include 14,946 women, 9,677 girls, 8,699 men, and 9,563 boys, with a particular focus on underserved ‎and marginalized communities. The project will run for 13 months and 16 days, from November 2024 to December 2025, with 10 months of ‎active intervention.‎ltbrgtltbgtProject Outcomes and Targeted Facilities:‎ltbrgt1- Health Services Enhancement ltbrgtTargeted Health Facilities: lt/bgtAl-Tawon Hajrin Health Center and Al-Akdan Health Center (Al Misrakh District), 26 September ‎Health Center ‎ltbrgtlt/pgtltpgtltbgtOutcomes 1.1:lt/bgt Improve access to essential health services for 27,420 individuals including (8,226 women, 5,758 girls, ‎‎7,952 men, and 5,484 boys)‎lt/pgtltpgtltbgtKey Interventions:lt/bgt The project will support these health facilities in delivering a comprehensive Minimum Service Package ‎‎(MSP), which includes trauma care, reproductive health, maternal and child health services, psychosocial support, ‎immunizations, and disease prevention.‎lt/pgtltpgtltbgtIndicators:‎lt/bgtlt/pgtltpgtltspangtltbgtHealthcare Consultations:lt/bgt Approximately 24,231 consultations will be supported for IDPs and host communities.‎lt/spangtlt/pgtltpgtltbgtReproductive Health Services:lt/bgt 1,776 services provided, with 777 antenatal care visits.‎lt/pgtltpgtltbgtMHPSS Services:lt/bgt Support to 1,745 individuals, including referrals for specialized care.‎lt/pgtltpgtltbgtReferrals:lt/bgt Facilitation of 100 critical cases to higher-level care.‎lt/pgtltpgtltbgt‎2.‎ Nutrition Services Improvement ltbrgtlt/bgtFully integrated health and nutrition services will be provided at Al-Tawon Hajrin HC, Al-Akdan HC, and 26 September HC, ‎addressing SAM, MAM, and PLW nutritional needs through screening, treatment, and counseling. Additionally, 14 October Health ‎Center (Salah district), Sainah Health Center, and Althwrh Health Center (Al Mudhafer district) will receive partial nutrition ‎services. These include IYCF counseling and screening and referral for SAM and MAM by (CHNVs)‎ltbrgtltbgtOutcomes 1.2:lt/bgt Improve nutrition outcomes for 7,998 children under five and 6,720 pregnant and lactating women (PLW) through integrated ‎screening, treatment, and counseling services.‎ltbrgtltbgtKey Interventions:‎ltbrgtlt/bgtltbgtScreening and Treatment:lt/bgt Screening for Severe and Moderate Acute Malnutrition (SAM and MAM) among children ‎under five, with referral to treatment programs as needed.‎ltbrgtltbgtOutpatient Therapeutic Programs (OTPs):lt/bgt Management and treatment of SAM and MAM cases in the three primary ‎health facilities.‎ltbrgtltbgtCounseling on Infant and Young Child Feeding (IYCF):lt/bgt Provided to 7,467 caregivers across all targeted health ‎facilities, promoting optimal feeding practices to prevent malnutrition.‎ltbrgtltbgtIndicators:lt/bgt‎ltbrgtltbgtSAM and MAM Screening:lt/bgt 7,998 children screened, with 1,048 treated for MAM and 244 for SAM.‎ltbrgtltbgtNutrition Treatment for PLW:lt/bgt 668 PLW treated for malnutrition.‎ltbrgtltbgtIYCF Counseling:lt/bgt Reaching 7,467 caregivers with essential nutrition knowledge.‎ltbrgtltbgtAdditional Project Outputs and Activitiesltbrgtlt/bgtltbgtHealth Education and Promotion:lt/bgt Reaching 5,998 individuals with vital information on health, nutrition, hygiene, and disease ‎prevention to promote healthier practices within the community.‎ltbrgtltbgtOperational Support for Health Facilities:lt/bgt Ensuring continuity of service delivery by providing essential medications, medical ‎supplies, minor facility rehabilitations, and staff incentives at the three main health facilities.‎ltbrgtltbgtWASH Improvements:lt/bgt Rehabilitation of water and sanitation systems, and installation of medical waste incinerators at key health ‎facilities to maintain safe, hygienic environments for both patients and staff.‎ltbrgtltbgtCoordination and Complementarityltbrgtlt/bgtDEEM will ensure full alignment with ongoing projects in the targeted health facilities to prevent any duplication or overlap, specifically ‎coordinating with World Bank (WB), WFP partners, and other implementing partners (IPs) active in the area to maximize resource utilization ‎and service impact.‎ltbrgtlt/pgt
